methods.candidate_pool: One fixed merge_method/density/scaling/output-rank specification; no validation search in wrapper; zero validation queries.
methods.cost_semantics: All basis fits, coordinate merging and optional compression occur inside wrapper and belong to candidate generation; model load/inference external. No zero-workspace or neural speed claim.
methods.definition: Per-layer dense effective deltas horizontally concatenated; SVD in float64; singular values >1e-5 retained; U,s,Vh converted float32; sV task blocks flattened globally across sorted layers; TIES merge then U reconstruction. Matches pinned official SVDMerger (concat_across_output=True), without DARE/other parameters.
methods.density_semantics: Inclusive kthvalue magnitude threshold d-floor(d*density); ties and threshold retain possibly more than requested density. No trim at density=1. Zero elected signs filled by majority elected-coordinate sign, then source >0/else<0 selection.
methods.input_semantics: Common base/layer, real ordinary LoRA, output-by-input effective update scale_i*B_i@A_i; biases/heads/DoRA/quantization excluded.
methods.output_rank: rank=None retains supported left basis width (capacity, possibly above numerical rank). Explicit rank adds SVD compression and is labeled adaptation. Output parameter count is B.numel()+A.numel(); unit output scale.
methods.reference_execution: Exact upstream apply_svd, ties_masking and masked_merge excerpts; orchestration uses two or more layer matrices and global flattening; no model runner.
methods.scope: Official language config uses alpha/r=1, common scaling=.5 and topK=100. Nonunit adapter scale handling is explicit extension. SVD threshold is absolute, not relative; no stability guarantee near cutoff.
